title: Testing sandbox
description: Isolated, ephemeral runs against mocked resources — scenario sims, deterministic replays and pre/post-deploy comparisons. Outputs are synthetic; no real target text is ever stored.

run.isolatedHint: The runner guarantees isolation: no egress, no secrets, no production. Recorded as reported by the runner, not inferred.
run.notIsolatedHint: This backend does not guarantee isolation — shown literally, not hidden.
run.destroyedHint: The ephemeral environment's state was discarded after the run.

runs.title: Runs
runs.description: Every isolated execution, with the backend that ran it and whether it was scored.
runs.isolationNote: Isolation is real, not faked: the runner and isolated flag are shown exactly as recorded. A degraded run was executed but not scored — it is not a pass.

outputs.title: Step outputs
outputs.syntheticNote: These are bounded synthetic outputs from the mock runner — not production output. A mock-miss is a deterministic marker; it never reached a real resource.

stream.replayNote: The engine replays this run's recorded step outputs over one connection and then closes it. A sandbox run executes synchronously when it is launched, so this is committed evidence arriving progressively — not the view of an execution still in flight.
stream.waiting: Waiting for the first step output — the connection state is shown above.
stream.completePartial: Replay ended, but it is not the whole record
stream.unreadable: Frames this view could not read: {{n}}. They arrived and were discarded, so the evidence they carried is missing here — this is not a clean replay.
stream.emptyUnreadable: No step output could be read
stream.lost: Connection lost — you have stopped seeing this run.
stream.lostHint: This is NOT the run finishing: the connection ended before the engine signalled the end of the replay. The run's status is the one the engine recorded, shown in the runs table — it is never derived from this connection. Reconnect to resume; outputs already shown are not repeated.
stream.snapshot: The stream delivered nothing, so these are the stored outputs read over the JSON API — a snapshot, not the live view.
stream.summary: Engine summary: {{ok}} of {{total}} steps resolved against a mock, {{error}} mock-misses.

comparisons.title: Pre/post-deploy comparisons
comparisons.description: Baseline versus candidate scored against the same suite — the verdict that gates a deploy.
comparisons.emptyHint: Run a compare to evaluate a candidate variant against its baseline.
comparisons.noSuite: No suite — verdict is inconclusive without a scored baseline and candidate.

scenarios.title: Scenarios
scenarios.description: Reusable specs of synthetic step inputs plus mocked MCP/resource responses.
scenarios.emptyHintAuthor: Record the first synthetic fixture: the step inputs a subject receives, plus the mocked responses they resolve against.
scenarios.emptyHintReadOnly: Scenarios are authored by a caller holding the sandbox scenario write permission. Without it you can read the ones that exist, and their runs.
scenarios.emptyHintConfined: Your membership is confined to a workspace. A scenario is a tenant-level fixture, so the engine refuses to record one from a confined membership — a tenant-wide member has to author it.

create.title: New scenario
create.description: A scenario is a synthetic fixture: the step inputs a subject receives, and the mocked MCP/resource responses they resolve against. Nothing here reaches a real resource.
create.name: Name
create.subjectKindHint: What the scenario exercises — agent, model, prompt or session. Free text, trimmed and stored up to 200 characters.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this fixture exercises, and why it exists.
create.stepsHint: The inputs the subject receives, in order. Leave a key blank and the engine assigns step-1, step-2, and so on.
create.stepsEmpty: No steps yet — a run of this scenario would produce no output.
create.mocksHint: The response each mocked MCP/resource returns. A step that finds no mock records a deterministic mock-miss marker — it never calls out.
create.mocksEmpty: No mocks yet — every step would record a mock-miss marker.
create.syntheticNote: Enter synthetic text only: nothing here is classified, redacted or rejected, so a secret you paste is a secret you have stored. The engine only bounds length — a name to 200 characters, a description to 1024, each step or mock body to 8192 — appending an ellipsis when it truncates.

archive.confirmBody: “{{name}}” is marked archived and the decision is recorded in the audit ledger. Runs and comparisons that already used it are kept — archiving never deletes evidence. It is a status change, not a block: the engine still runs a scenario in this state if something asks it to.

seam.syntheticData: Synthetic-data generation is a documented post-v1 extension point — not implemented in this version.

runs.title: No sandbox runs recorded yet
runs.description: Runs appear after an authorized caller starts a stored scenario, replay or comparison through the sandbox API.

scenarios.title: No sandbox scenarios defined yet
scenarios.description: A scenario is an operator-authored synthetic fixture, recorded by a caller who holds the sandbox scenario write permission — from this screen or through the sandbox API.

actions.replayHint: Re-executes a historical session deterministically against mocks. If the timeline cannot be reconstructed the replay comes back DEGRADED with zero steps — that is not a session that did nothing, it is a timeline that could not be rebuilt.
actions.compareHint: A comparison is pre/post-deploy DECISION evidence and is stored append-only, which is why it needs the admin tier rather than the one that merely runs.
